_about: Public-domain James Hudson Taylor (1832-1905, founder of the China Inland Mission) for the Word Hoard: China: its Spiritual Need and Claims, in its third edition (London: Nisbet, 1868) and seventh edition (London: Morgan & Scott, 1887), from Internet Archive scans. His later booklets survive only in undated printings and are held as pending. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hudson-taylor-china-need-1868: China: its Spiritual Need and Claims, third edition (London: James Nisbet; W. Partridge, 1868)
hudson-taylor-china-need-1887: China's Spiritual Need and Claims, seventh edition (London: Morgan & Scott, 1887)

_pending.hudson-taylor-undated: A Retrospect (PG 26744), Union and Communion (PG 26172), Separation and Service (PG 26384) and A Ribband of Blue (PG 23438): their title pages carry no year, and the CCEL Union and Communion records impressions to July 1929, so a pre-1930 printing is not proven
